verse_number.description: Verse number to display (1–423); if omitted and not 'all', a random verse is printed

verse_range.description: Special value 'all' to print all verses; mutually exclusive with verse_number

verses.description: Explicit list of verse numbers to display (e.g., [1, 10, 20]); used only if neither verse_number nor verse_range='all' is specified
